==Skin Trivia==
*The {{Color|Premium|Cold Soldier}} skin was originally based on the [[w:c:marvelcinematicuniverse:Winter Soldier|Winter Soldier]] in the Marvel Universe.
**The {{Color|Premium|Cold Soldier}} was originally planned to be named Bucky Barnes or Winter Soldier.
**Hilariously, the {{Color|Premium|Cold Soldier}} is referred as the "{{Color|Premium|Cold Soldier}} Soldier" in game.
*The original {{Color|Premium|Cold Soldier}} icon used its Level 5 upgrade, without the shades and with an M16A2 instead of a G36.
*The first version of the Default skin's Level 4+ armor was the [[w:c:R2DA:Flakvest|Flakvest]] from ''R2DA''.
**The same mesh was used for the Level 4 armor for the second version of the Default skin, and the first version of the {{Color|Basic|Red}}, {{Color|Basic|Blue}} and {{Color|Party|Party}} skins, though in a different color.
*The original version of the {{Color|Toy|Toy}} skin's Level 3-4 gun is the [https://www.amazon.com/NERF-Fortnite-AR-L-Elite-Blaster/dp/B07MBK23M2 NERF-Fortnite-AR-L-Elite-Blaster].
*The {{Color|Toy|Toy}} and {{Color|Golden}} '''Soldier''' have unique shooting sounds.
*The {{Color|Toy|Toy}} skin is based on the [[wp:Army men|Army men plastic soldiers]].
*The {{Color|Premium|Doughboy}} skin is a reference to the American Infantrymen during World War One, who were popularly called doughboys.
*There were multiple times where the {{Color|Premium|Doughboy}} skin's animations and upgrades were bugged and later fixed.
*The {{Color|Premium|Holiday Soldier}} skin's backpack disappears at Level 3 and reappears at Level 4.
**This may have been a developer mistake.
*The {{Color|Premium|Liberator}} skin is based on the [https://helldivers.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Helldivers Helldivers] uniform.
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Grand Theft}} skin's name appears to be a reference to the ''Grand Theft Auto'' series, though the skin itself does not appear to resemble anything from any game until Level 4.
**The Level 4 appearance has a horse head which resembles the [https://gta.wiki/w/Masks_(clothing)/GTA_Online Chestnut Horse mask] purchasable in ''Grand Theft Auto Online''.
*The {{Color|Premium|Stealth Ops}} skin is based on [[w:c:killzone:Helghast Army|Helghast Soldiers]] from the ''Killzone'' franchise.
**The skin was originally called ''Extrasolar Warrior''<ref>https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/892156782347161690/1283614502473957396</ref> before being changed to its current name. The former name references the [[w:c:killzone:First Extrasolar War|Extrasolar Wars]].
*The {{Color|OperationICE|Dark Frost}} skin on its in-game icon skin has purple skin, however, this is mostly not the case in-game.
**Its torso and legs are still purple, though this is only clearly visible at Level 4.
**This was likely a mistake caused by the {{Color|OperationICE|Dark Frost}} skin being confused with the {{Color|OperationICE|Frost Legion}} skins, which actually do use purple skin tones.
*The {{Color|Beach}} skin was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/313445649/profile supereroulnoptizet].<ref>https://x.com/LinxtheDev/status/2085765772249362647</ref>
**The {{Color|Beach}} skin was originally made as a [[Frost Blaster]] skin, however, it ended up getting converted into a '''Soldier''' skin instead.<ref>https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/600908514847883294/1535494477559365702 (Tower Defense Simulator Server)</ref><ref>https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/600908514847883294/1535590448792469505 (Tower Defense Simulator Server)</ref>
***Certain parts of the design like the [[Frost Blaster]] weapon look did get carried over to the '''Soldier''' version of the skin.<ref>https://discord.com/channels/735394249863987241/735394249863987244/1535672814382747649 (Tower Defense Simulator Wiki Server)</ref>
